title: Chinese Decision: A Family of Language Models for Single-Pass Probabilistic Decision-Making
abstract: arXiv:2610.23170v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many language-based applications require probabilities over a finite set of decisions rather than open-ended responses. We present Chinese Decision, a family of Chinese-language models for single-pass probabilistic decision-making. Given context, an instruction, and candidate descriptions, the model extracts final-position candidate-letter logits in one forward pass and normalizes them over valid options, without autoregressive answer generation. A shared interface supports Boolean judgments, categorical choices, and ordinal scores. translated_title: Chinese Decision（中文决策）：面向单次前向概率决策的语言模型系列
translated_abstract: 许多基于语言的应用需要对有限决策集合输出概率分布，而非开放式回答。我们提出了 Chinese Decision（中文决策），一个面向单次前向概率决策的中文语言模型系列。给定上下文、指令和候选描述，模型在单次前向传播中提取末尾位置的候选字母 logits，并在有效选项上进行归一化，无需自回归式答案生成。统一的共享接口支持布尔判断、类别选择和序数评分。我们报告了一个已完成的 0.8B 模型，该模型使用分布交叉熵在 1304.8 万个决策上训练；此外还报告了经过额外 RLCD 目标训练的初步 2B 检查点。在包含 307,900 个决策的完整 CJ-Bench 上，未经校准的 0.8B 模型仅使用单一检查点，在通用领域达到 72.24% 的准确率，在医学、法律和金融领域平均达到 76.98% 的准确率，整体期望校准误差为 1.07%。
tldr: Chinese Decision 是一系列中文语言模型，通过单次前向传播直接对候选选项的 logits 进行归一化得到概率分布，无需自回归生成，在医学、法律、金融等领域的决策任务上实现了高准确率与良好校准。
en_tdlr: Chinese Decision is a family of Chinese language models that perform single-pass probabilistic decision-making by extracting and normalizing final-position candidate logits in one forward pass, achieving high accuracy and calibration on medical, legal, and financial decisions without autoregressive generation.
